text: 为更好匹配银行体系短期流动性需求，中国人民银行将在8月14日、8月17日至8月19日开展隔夜逆回购操作，采用固定利率、数量招标，每日操作量不超过6000亿元。(央行)
text_en: To better match short-term liquidity demand in the banking system, the People's Bank of China will conduct overnight reverse repurchase operations on August 14 and August 17-19, using fixed interest rates and quantity tenders, with a daily operation cap of no more than 600 billion yuan. (PBOC)
